name: Alarm System Awareness & Avoidance
description: Motion detectors, door contacts, glass break sensors, and PIR sensors are the primary electronic detection layer in most commercial facilities. Understanding sensor placement from recon, technology type, and coverage areas allows route planning that minimizes alarm activation. Most PIR sensors have a reset time after activation that can be exploited for movement timing. Identifying alarm system vendors during recon allows research of known sensor blind spots.

tools.name: Motion sensor detection via IR monocular

blue.det: Alarm activation if evasion fails; unusual tampering with sensor housings; motion near sensors without activation.
blue.cm: Dual-technology sensors (PIR + microwave); tamper-evident sensor housings; supervised alarm zones that alert on sensor disconnection.
